method:
Complete native SOURCE review of forest studies 6..10.

The catalogs and layer/adjacency diagrams are source constructions, not mGBA
captures. They disclose logical collision separately from visual aliases.
Palette-pulse previews use authored BG bank states with fixed inspection holds;
they never grade a screenshot or claim to reproduce the running game's clock.

native_palette_phase_groups.name: dead-tree
native_palette_phase_groups.hardware_role: Assembled native BG tiles; four palette states of one bitmap, not appended sprite frames.

native_palette_phase_groups.hardware_role: Assembled native BG tiles; four palette states of one bitmap, not appended sprite frames.

animations.kind: Authored BG blight palette phases; all source indices held fixed.
Discrete interaction inspection states, not event timing.
Authored bitmap phases; palette held atphase0; not game cadence.

layer_semantics.canopy: Semantic SOLID15; rounded aliases do not erase collision.
layer_semantics.arch: FLOOR0 overlay. Walkable lower route, no upper deck.
layer_semantics.log: Two full SOLID15 cells, not an underpass.
layer_semantics.relic: Tall marker at MOSSY_STONE FLOOR0; legacy RELIC tile is not live placement.
layer_semantics.shrine: Tall marker at statue; lower two8px quarters blocked; pad below stays walkable.
